watch.summary: A Rocket League player hypes himself up to extend his lead to 5 goals, only to immediately concede a goal right after kickoff.

beats.what: Creator gives himself a pep talk to try and win by 5 goals.
The final kickoff begins with seconds left.
Creator whiffs his defensive attempt on the ball.
The opponent scores, ruining the challenge.
Creator bursts out into hysterics at how fast he failed.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: do I have what it takes to do a five-five?
watch.why: The instant contrast between his calm self-motivation and the immediate goal conceded creates a classic hubris-then-fail dynamic. His uncontrollable laughter at his own mistake makes the moment contagious.
